title: Yarn lockfile entry without a resolved version
description: yarn.lock declares a Yarn entry that records no version. The entry cannot be compared with an advisory range, so a vulnerable install is invisible to every version-based check.
remediation: Run `yarn install` against the unchanged `package.json` and commit the regenerated `yarn.lock`, so each entry records the version Yarn actually installed.
limitation: It matches a Yarn entry that records no version in the parsed yarn.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
